newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh unveils women development policy.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh unveils women development policy.

text.p: Bangladesh's Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday unveiled the country's first women development policy pledging to protect women's rights and ensure their equal participation in national activities.
"A national action plan for women development have been formulated to execute the policy," Hasina told a rally marking international women's day.
Hasina became Bangladesh's second woman prime minister in June last year defeating her arch rival former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia.

"My government will encourage any innovative endeavours for raising standards for women and impose a ban on technology contrary to their welfare," she said to cheers from thousands of women and children.
She said her government was determined to implement the "Beijing declaration" that aims at develpment of women.
Hasina is daughter of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, Bangladesh's independence leader who was killed along with most his family in a military coup in August 1975.
